visual_base.visual_narrative_log:
(1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair and round glasses speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit professional office. She wears a beige knitted sweater and a silver ring. The background shows a picture frame, a gold trophy, and various skincare products on white shelves.
(2) A sudden cut shows a close-up of a young child's face with bright red, irritated skin on the cheek and ear. The child wears a knitted yellow hat. The lighting is natural and highlights the skin's texture. Red variety text overlays the image for emphasis.
(3) The woman returns, gesturing with open palms toward the camera lens. A circular inset shows a microscopic or highly magnified view of red, irritated skin texture. Behind her, the office setting remains consistent with soft, warm indoor lighting and shallow depth.
(4) A split-screen comparison displays two images of red skin. On the left, text says 蠕形蟎蟲, and on the right, 臉頰凍傷. The woman's hands move actively as she explains the visual similarities between the two conditions to the viewers.
(5) Digital snowflake graphics float around the woman. Variety text 最近寒流 一定是頻繁來到 appears in white. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot. The woman's facial expressions are highly animated and expressive, emphasizing the impact of the cold weather.
(6) An extreme close-up of skin pores appears, filling the frame. Yellow variety text 中性 偏乾性肌膚人 is centered. This visual focus on skin texture illustrates the specific skin type vulnerable to the cold. The lighting is very bright and clinical.
(7) The woman talks while a cartoon icon of a person on a blue scooter appears on her right. She uses hand gestures to simulate riding a scooter. The background clinic office is neatly organized with professional awards and white furniture.
(8) A green watermelon-patterned helmet graphic is superimposed on the woman's head as she mimes the action of putting on a helmet. Her playful gestures and the digital overlay create a humorous and engaging visual explanation of local Taiwanese commuting habits.
(9) The woman points to her cheeks, followed by another close-up of red, inflamed skin. Bold red variety text 你的臉頰 一定會發炎 and 因為過冷 appears with ice-blue accents, emphasizing the physical consequences of exposure to cold winter wind.
(10) She gestures with her hands while explaining common medical misconceptions. A circular inset of red skin is shown again with text 這是酒糟! and 皮膚發炎. The woman's glasses reflect the studio lighting as she speaks with high authority.
(11) Close-up photos of red, scaly skin on cheeks are shown. Text 臉上的濕疹這個東西 and 他皮膚 就是真正發炎了 overlays these medical-style images. The woman is visible in the background, continuing her explanation with focused and energetic hand movements.
(12) A meme image of a confused white cat with several yellow question marks around its head appears. The woman is seen laughing and gesturing, creating a lighthearted moment before transitioning into the professional solution phase of the video.
(13) Two product images are showcased: a white bottle of CeraVe serum and a tube of La Roche-Posay B5 Cicaplast Baume. The woman's hands are clasped as she recommends these products. The text 這時候我就會叫 你拿出來用 appears.
(14) The woman gestures toward her face and then shows three fingers. Variety text 這個會對你 有幫助 and 拿個類固醇擦一擦 三天一定會下來 appears in yellow and white. Her expression is confident and very reassuring to the viewers.
(15) The video cuts to a final information screen with a white background and the DRX logo. Contact details including Line ID, phone number, and two clinic addresses are listed in a clean, professional layout. Text contact us is at the bottom.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Identification of Medical Problem -> Explanation of Causes -> Product Recommendation -> Professional Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on distinguishing between Demodex mites and winter windburn, particularly for motorcycle riders in Taiwan during cold fronts. It provides professional medical advice and skincare product recommendations to treat inflamed skin.
